remediation.action: Upgrade the Astro 7-compatible release line and regenerate the lockfile
remediation.result: The site moved from Astro 6.4.8/@astrojs-node 10.1.4 to Astro 7.1.0/@astrojs-node 11.0.3. This is the smallest compatible major transition that satisfies the OSV/GHSA patched ranges; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile passed.

remainingBlocker: No dependency advisories remain in the final pnpm audit. Production distribution remains subject to the separate provenance/key-custody decisions in ADR 011.
majorDecision: A major update is required: @astrojs/node 11.0.3 declares peer astro ^7.0.0, while the Astro 6 line cannot satisfy the patched GHSA-4g3v-8h47-v7g6 range. The selected Astro 7.1.0 and @astrojs/node 11.0.3 are the smallest compatible patched versions verified by site typecheck/build and Nx builds.
